## Open findings

### High (2)

- `coding-mcp-blank-row-blocks-save-silently` — **CodingMcpSection** — Save blocks on a blank server row without saying so — `client/settings/sections/CodingMcpSection.svelte:266`
- `coding-mcp-duplicate-server-saves-silently` — **CodingMcpSection** — The same MCP server can be selected twice and saved — `client/settings/sections/CodingMcpSection.svelte:99`

### Med (8)

- `admin-users-live-region-mounts-with-text` — **AdminUsersSection** — Status and error regions mount with their announcement already inside them
- `coding-mcp-actions-row-escapes-card-alignment` — **CodingMcpSection** — The actions row is misaligned with the row cards on both edges — `client/settings/sections/CodingMcpSection.svelte:321`
- `coding-mcp-async-actions-never-announce-busy` — **CodingMcpSection** — Save and Clear change their label while saving but never announce it — `client/settings/sections/CodingMcpSection.svelte:262`
- `coding-mcp-error-state-buries-what-failed` — **CodingMcpSection** — The error state headlines a raw exception and never says what failed — `client/settings/sections/CodingMcpSection.svelte:184`
- `coding-mcp-peer-field-widths-diverge` — **CodingMcpSection** — Two peer fields in one row differ in width by nearly 4× — `client/settings/sections/CodingMcpSection.svelte:315`
- `coding-mcp-server-cap-unexplained` — **CodingMcpSection** — The server cap disables Add with no indication a cap exists — `client/settings/sections/CodingMcpSection.svelte:59`
- `plugins-inactive-copy-overclaims-approval` — **PluginsSection** — The ineligible-plugin sentence names approval as the remedy for six different states — `client/settings/lib/plugin-eligibility.ts:44`
- `transcript-aria-live-history-race` — **TranscriptApp** — The history bulk-load can be announced as if it were live

### Low (6)

- `admin-users-username-truncates-silently` — **AdminUsersSection** — A long username truncates with no way to read it on keyboard or touch
- `coding-mcp-empty-states-are-bare-prose` — **CodingMcpSection** — Both empty states are bare prose rather than the shared empty-state primitive — `client/settings/sections/CodingMcpSection.svelte:190`
- `coding-mcp-live-region-mounts-with-text` — **CodingMcpSection** — Status and error regions mount with their announcement already inside them — `client/settings/sections/CodingMcpSection.svelte:178`
- `coding-mcp-remove-live-during-save` — **CodingMcpSection** — Remove stays clickable while every other control locks during a save — `client/settings/sections/CodingMcpSection.svelte:228`
- `settings-app-focus-ring-scoped-to-grid` — **SettingsApp** — The focus ring's colour is a hardcoded literal instead of the accent token — `client/shared/tokens.css:39`
- `settings-app-jump-menu-ignores-collapse` — **SettingsApp** — Re-picking the jump menu's current section does nothing

## Deferred

- `repos-no-edit-capability` — **ReposSection** — A repository can only be added or deleted, never edited
- `settings-app-no-shared-type-scale` — **SettingsApp** — No shared type scale, so every component invents its own font sizes
